decisions.what: Preserved existing arvad_task_files/ ignore entry in .gitignore
decisions.why: The .gitignore already contained a line ignoring arvad_task_files/; this entry was retained and the new OS/IDE/log/build patterns were appended below it to avoid losing existing configuration.

decisions.what: Wrote comprehensive README.md replacing the truncated original
decisions.why: The existing README was a single incomplete sentence. The spec required a full replacement with all specified sections.

decisions.what: Created index.html HTML structure first, then added CSS/JS links as a separate edit
decisions.why: Spec 001 defined the HTML structure; spec 004 explicitly adds the <link> and <script> tags as a distinct modification step

decisions.what: Used Unsplash image URLs for hero background and vehicle card images
decisions.why: Spec required Unsplash URLs with proper alt text; no local images exist in the project

decisions.what: Implemented IIFE pattern with 'use strict' in js/main.js
decisions.why: Spec explicitly required IIFE pattern to avoid global scope pollution and strict mode

decisions.what: Added defer attribute to the script tag in index.html
decisions.why: Spec required defer for non-blocking load

decisions.what: Used IntersectionObserver for active nav highlighting
decisions.why: More performant than a raw scroll event listener; debounced scroll handler still used for sticky header shadow

decisions.what: CSS custom properties match spec exactly: --primary-color #1a73e8, --secondary-color #34a853, --text-dark #202124, --text-light #5f6368, --bg-light #f8f9fa, --spacing-unit 8px
decisions.why: Spec specified exact variable names and values

decisions.what: Mobile-first CSS with breakpoints at 640px, 768px, 1024px
decisions.why: Spec required mobile-first media queries; 640px added for 2-col vehicle grid on small tablets, 768px for desktop nav, 1024px for 3-col grid and side-by-side about layout

decisions.what: Used .inventory-card class instead of reusing .vehicle-card for inventory page cards
decisions.why: Avoids conflicts with existing .vehicle-card styles on the homepage and allows independent styling for list/grid views

decisions.what: Placed loading spinner inside #vehicle-grid; renderVehicles() removes cards via DOM API (not innerHTML) to preserve the spinner node
decisions.why: innerHTML clear would destroy the spinner reference; querySelectorAll + removeChild preserves it while clearing rendered cards

decisions.what: Mobile filter sidebar uses max-height accordion (0 to 1200px) toggled by .sidebar-open class
decisions.why: CSS-only animation approach; JS only toggles the class and aria-expanded attribute

decisions.what: Empty state (#empty-state) is a sibling to #vehicle-grid, not inside it
decisions.why: Prevents the empty state from being unintentionally removed when inventory cards are cleared from the grid

decisions.what: fetchVehicles() fetches from data/vehicles.json at runtime via fetch()
decisions.why: data/vehicles.json is a runtime data file, not an ES module import; fetch is correct and appropriate regardless of the forbidden_imports list

decisions.what: Added js/inventory.js script tag with defer before </body> in inventory.html (step 4)
decisions.why: Non-blocking deferred load ensures DOM-ready execution, matching the established pattern from main.js

decisions.what: Created data/ directory before writing vehicles.json
decisions.why: The directory did not exist on disk; it was referenced in the README folder structure but not present in the working tree

decisions.what: Used 13 vehicles covering all 8 specified makes with type distribution 4 Sedan / 3 Truck / 4 SUV / 2 Coupe
decisions.why: 13 is within the required 12-15 range and was the minimum needed to include all 8 makes (Toyota, Honda, Ford, Chevrolet, BMW, Mercedes-Benz, Nissan, Mazda)

decisions.what: Included fuelType Hybrid for the 2023 Toyota RAV4
decisions.why: Spec requires fuelType variety including Hybrid; all other vehicles use Gasoline which is realistic for the inventory mix

decisions.what: Inserted Managing Vehicle Inventory section after Folder Structure in README and retained existing Content Management section
decisions.why: Spec placement is explicitly after Folder Structure; existing Content Management section was preserved to avoid removing prior documentation

decisions.what: vehicle-detail.html created without vehicle-detail.js script tag in spec 1, then script tag added in spec 4
decisions.why: Specs applied sequentially: spec 1 creates the base template; spec 4 explicitly modifies the file to add the deferred script tag

decisions.what: Lightbox implemented as a div with role=dialog/aria-modal rather than native <dialog>
decisions.why: Spec describes a custom overlay div with prev/next/close buttons; role=dialog with aria-modal maintains accessibility while matching the specified layout structure

decisions.what: Vehicle ID regex allows hyphens: /^[a-zA-Z0-9-]{1,20}$/
decisions.why: All real vehicle IDs in vehicles.json use format 'veh-001'; strictly alphanumeric-only would reject all valid IDs

decisions.what: fetchRelatedVehicles makes a second fetch to vehicles.json rather than reusing already-loaded data
decisions.why: Spec requires an independent async function; no shared in-memory data store exists on this static site

decisions.what: CSS vehicle detail styles appended to end of existing styles.css
decisions.why: Spec says to extend the existing stylesheet; appending preserves existing rules and follows the established section-comment pattern
